outcome.technical: Restored plugins/audit/hooks/_config.py, guard-history-rewrite.py, guard-secrets-read.py, .claude/hooks/guard-uncommitted.py and .claude/hooks/guard-release.py to their text at the branch point (git show d981a743:<path>); every phase commit touching _config.py was guard heredoc work, so no non-guard helper was lost (names other files use - _ask_rev_parse, _call_start_path, _command_facts, _handed_command and the guards' _substitutions, git_calls, amend_requested, _copy_targets, _session_base, _git_verb, _hooks_config, _effective - all still defined, checked by grep). Then added ONE transform, _config.lift_house_bodies(cmd), with ONE sink table _HOUSE_SINKS (git commit -m/-F/--message past -C <path> and --no-pager; git tag -m; gh pr|issue create|edit --body/--title; the audit-task script by stem at an absolute or variable-rooted path, add|scope|done|cancel|note with --description/--title/--outcome/--reason/--text; no .py literal). It removes a body only when: the word is exactly a double-quoted $(cat <<'D' or <<"D" with nothing after the marker on its line, D alone on its own line, then )" ending the word; the quoting before it is provably plain (no $' or $", no open quote, no escaped newline, no $( or backquote, no ${...} with an operator, no comment); nothing in the body is a ')' (measured: macOS /bin/bash 3.2 matches the $( parenthesis over raw text, so a body line ')"' ended the substitution and ran the lines after it); and every clause of the command is one _house_frame_clause lists (cd; git with -C/--no-pager only and a verb from _HOUSE_FRAME_GIT with no --exec/--receive-pack/--upload-pack/--output; gh pr/issue; the audit-task script), joined by ; && || & or newline - any pipe, redirect, group or other heredoc means no lift. Any doubt returns the command byte for byte. Wired before every reading: guard-history-rewrite decide, guard-secrets-read decide (Bash branch), guard-uncommitted reading (after the cheap text door, through the parser's _config; the door re-asked on the lifted text), guard-release _publishers and _session_base via a _lifted() helper that keeps the raw text if _config cannot be loaded.
